biotools.summary: Python package that decomposes Raman spectra into baseline, cosmic rays, noise and peaks with convolutional neural networks. It includes two pre-trained models (standard and ensemble), a synthetic data generator, training and fine-tuning tools, evaluation metrics, a command-line tool, and readers and writers for the common Raman file formats (SPC, JCAMP-DX, Renishaw WDF, Horiba LabSpec, TriVista, instrument text exports, Excel, Parquet, SQLite, HDF5, MATLAB, JSON, NumPy).
